BESTIARY.Title: Bestiary

Keybinding.OpenHint: Opens or closes the Bestiary window. Every user can bind their own key.

Settings.OpenBestiaryHint: Use the button above to open the Bestiary. You can also use the hotkey (Shift+B by default) or the button in the Journal tab.
Settings.GuideMenuHint: Interactive walkthrough of Bestiary Journal features, shortcuts, research tiers, and tips.
Settings.TierMenuHint: World-wide rules: at which tier each block of a creature card is revealed.
Settings.AllowSharingHint: Players may share creatures they have studied. Nobody can pass on more than they know themselves.
Settings.SharingWindowHint: Telling others about a creature takes time. "After a rest": the character must take a short or long rest after their last fight. Outside "Always", nobody can share during combat.
Settings.ResearchRollHint: Players can raise a tier by rolling a skill check straight from the creature card.
Settings.SingleAttemptHint: After a failed check, retries are blocked until the GM resets that knowledge.
Settings.IncludeCustomSkillsHint: Add all non-standard skills registered in D&D 5e (for example via SystemCustomizer) to the skills available for research checks.
Settings.DebugHint: Write detailed Bestiary Journal diagnostics to the browser console on this device.
Settings.OnboardingHintsHint: Automatically greets new users once on first open and shows quick tips and inline hints inside windows.
Settings.ThemeHint: How the bestiary windows look for you. «Auto» follows Foundry's colour scheme; «As in AIM» uses the theme and accent of AIM: Actor Window when it is active.
Settings.AccentHint: The colour of selections, buttons and focus in the bestiary windows.
Settings.MotionHint: On this device. Reduced motion in the system turns them off, Foundry's low performance mode reduces them.
Settings.EncounterRevealHint: When a visible enemy creature from the bestiary fights the party, every player who does not know it yet gets «Rumors» about it.
Settings.EncounterRevealOnUnhideHint: When «Meeting in combat» is enabled, also grant «Rumors» immediately if a hidden enemy combatant or token is revealed during an active fight.
Settings.EncounterRevealTierHint: Which research tier uninformed players receive when encountering a visible enemy from the bestiary.
Settings.DensityHint: Spacing inside the library, collection lists and creature cards.
Settings.CoverSizeHint: Size of collection covers in the library on this device.

Guide.Title: Guide & Features
Guide.LeadGm: Everything you need to build themed creature collections, customize knowledge tiers, and reveal lore without spoilers.
Guide.LeadPlayer: Learn how to research monsters in the field, share discoveries with allies, and keep private or party notes.
Guide.ShowInlineHints: Show tips banner & inline hints in windows
Guide.BannersRestored: Tip banner restored in the library overview.
Guide.LiveLadderHint: These are the active tiers configured by your GM. Progress increases step-by-step from 0 upward.
Guide.TooltipImport: Import JSON snapshot — merge or replace bestiary collections, families, and tier rules
Guide.TooltipExportAll: Export full bestiary structure (collections, tiers, framing) to JSON
Guide.TooltipTierSettings: Research tiers — customize tier names, icons, colors, and block reveal thresholds
Guide.TooltipBoard: Party knowledge board — view and edit every player's tier across all creatures at once
Guide.TooltipBulkResearch: Bulk check settings — set research DC and allowed skills for a whole collection or family
Guide.TooltipCreateFamily: Create a family subgroup inside this collection (drag creatures between groups)
Guide.TooltipExportSection: Export this collection's structure and custom thresholds to JSON
Guide.TooltipBulkImport: Bulk import — select NPCs from World Actors or Compendiums with type/CR filters
Guide.TooltipPreviewAs: Preview as player — view this card with the exact silhouettes and hidden traits a player sees
Guide.TooltipEntryEditor: Entry settings — adjust research DC, skills, custom token/portrait framing, and focal point
Guide.TooltipSendToChat: Post creature card to Foundry chat (respects what players currently know)
Guide.TooltipShare: Share your knowledge tier for this creature with other players
Guide.InlinePreviewHint: Tip: double-click opens the full card (or sheet for GMs); drag any card into Chat to post a @Bestiary link.
Guide.InlineResearchTip: Roll a skill check to unlock the next research tier. Once studied, use Share or drag cards to Chat!
Guide.InlineItemPinTip: Tip: you can also pin individual traits, attacks, or spells via the eye dropdown next to each item in the statblock.
Guide.TipGmImportBody: Drag NPC actors or folders into a collection, click Bulk Import to pull from Compendiums, or click the book icon right on a selected token's HUD / NPC sheet.
Guide.TipGmTiersBody: Open Manage in the bottom-left sidebar (or Module Settings) to insert custom tiers up to 10 levels with custom icons and colors — all progress remaps automatically.
Guide.TipGmPreviewBody: Use the player dropdown at the top of any creature card to see exact silhouettes and test «Meeting in combat» safely without spoiling hidden ambushes.
Guide.TipGmBoardBody: Change any creature's tier for one player, for the whole party in one click, or batch-select rows on Party Knowledge — and use the eye dropdown beside any attack or spell to hide it down to «GM only».
Guide.TipPlayerResearchBody: Open any creature card and click «Roll a check» under Knowledge to advance one tier when your character passes the DC.
Guide.TipPlayerShareBody: Click Share in a creature card's top bar or Knowledge tab to teach teammates up to what you know (outside combat or after a rest, depending on world rules).
Guide.TipPlayerNotesBody: Switch channels in a creature's Notes tab: Private notes stay strictly yours on the server (invisible even to the GM), while Party notes gather in one shared feed.
Guide.TipSharedChatTitle: Drag cards to Chat & press «/» to search
Guide.TipSharedChatBody: Drag any creature card straight into Foundry Chat to share an interactive @Bestiary link, or press «/» to focus search immediately.
Guide.StepGm1Body: Group encounters by region, chapter, or dungeon. Right-click any collection card to hide prep work from players or lock changes.
Guide.StepGm2Body: Open a collection and drag NPCs/folders in, run Bulk Import from Compendiums (with optional copy-to-world), or use the Book button on a Token HUD or NPC sheet.
Guide.StepGm3Body: Customize up to 10 research tiers with your own names, icons, and colors, adjust global block thresholds, and pin specific traits or spells on individual cards.
Guide.StepGm4Body: Turn on «Meeting in combat» for automatic discovery (ambushes stay hidden until revealed!), manage the party on Knowledge Board, and inspect cards via «Preview as player».
Guide.StepPlayer1Body: Unknown creatures appear as silhouettes; blue dots highlight entries newly unlocked or updated since you last opened them.
Guide.StepPlayer2Title: Raise your tier with research checks
Guide.StepPlayer2Body: On any creature card's Knowledge tab, pick your character and allowed skill, then roll to unlock deeper statistics step-by-step.
Guide.StepPlayer3Body: Click Share on a creature you've studied to bring teammates up to your tier (respecting combat or rest rules configured by your GM).
Guide.StepPlayer4Body: Save strictly private tactical reminders or post shared Party notes, star favourites, and drag cards into Foundry Chat.
Guide.GmCardPopulateBody: Drag actors or folders straight onto a collection, pull batches from Compendiums via Bulk Import, or add monsters on the fly from Token HUD and NPC sheets.
Guide.GmCardCustomTiersBody: Insert levels anywhere in the ladder, rename defaults, choose icons and contrast-safe colors. Player knowledge and block rules remap automatically.
Guide.GmCardGranularBody: Set default thresholds globally, override per creature on the card's Tiers rail, or pin individual traits, reactions, and spells down to «GM only».
Guide.GmCardPreviewBody: Select any player in the top dropdown of a creature card to see their exact silhouettes, research panel, and revealed statistics in real time.
Guide.GmCardEncounterBody: Optionally grant a configured tier when combat starts or when a hidden token loses stealth mid-fight — while keeping hidden enemies and friendly NPCs concealed.
Guide.GmCardBoardBody: See everyone's tier for every creature in one grid and grant knowledge to individual players or the whole party with a single bulk apply.
Guide.GmCardBulkResearchBody: Apply a shared DC or custom D&D 5e skills across a whole collection or family at once without overwriting locked entries.
Guide.GmCardTransferBody: Export or import collections with merge/replace diff previews. Keep GM notes strictly hidden until you click «Show to players».
Guide.ResearchCardRollBodyGm: Players trigger checks from creature cards; your active GM client verifies character ownership, skill eligibility, freshness, and single-attempt rules before revealing.
Guide.ResearchCardRollBodyPlayer: Select your character and allowed skill in the Knowledge rail and roll. When the active GM client validates success, your tier increases by one.
Guide.ResearchCardShareBody: Knowledge spreads no higher than what the sharer knows and never lowers anyone else. The GM can restrict sharing to Out of combat or After a rest.
Guide.ResearchCardNotesBody: Notes live in permission-scoped JournalEntries: Private notes are visible only to their author (not even the GM), Party notes to everyone, and GM notes stay hidden until shared.
Guide.ResearchCardFeedBody: Every Party note and published GM note aggregates in the Library's Party Notes view for quick campaign review. Pin key notes and press Ctrl+Enter to submit.
Guide.ShortcutOpenBody: Press your configured hotkey anywhere on the canvas, or click the Bestiary button inside Foundry's Journals sidebar tab.
Guide.ShortcutSearchBody: Press «/» inside the Library or any Collection to focus search immediately, and press «Esc» to clear the query or close the filter drawer.
Guide.ShortcutChatLinkBody: Drag any creature card from the Library or Collection into Foundry's chat input to create a clickable @Bestiary[uuid] link adapting to each viewer's tier.
Guide.ShortcutLookBody: Click the palette button in the top-right header to pick Night or Parchment theme, 6 accent colors, Compact density, cover sizes, and animations.
Guide.ShortcutApiBody: Automate reveals in macros with game.bestiaryJournal (openCreature, openGuide, getTier, grantKnowledge, plus the bestiaryJournalRefresh hook).
